hints.title: Repeated Modulo Extraction
hints.text: Repeatedly extract the least significant digit in base k by computing n modulo k.

hints.title: Base Reduction
hints.text: Divide n by k via integer division at each step and accumulate remainder digits.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: Continue the process until n reaches 0 and return the accumulated digit sum.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting to a full string representation introduces unnecessary string allocation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Iterative arithmetic extracting remainder digits executes in logarithmic time and constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate performs base conversion via division and modulo operations.
